name: Truist Enjoy Travel Credit Card

apr.notes: 18.99% to 27.99% variable APR. Cash advance APR 27.99% (Prime plus 20.99%).

base_rate.description: 1x miles on all other eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem miles for cash back, gift cards, hotel stays, airline tickets and merchandise. A 10% to 50% Loyalty Travel Bonus applies, based on the Truist deposit relationship, when rewards are redeemed for travel.

signup_bonus.description: 20,000 bonus miles after spending $1,500 within 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck or Global Entry credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $85 for the TSA PreCheck or Global Entry fee once every four years.

notes: The product page links both Visa Signature and Visa Traditional benefit guides, so the package depends on the account and network_tier is none.
